shaped_collection_standalones.boundary: Independently readable preservation/manuscript bodies. Where a body declares that fuller source remains in the Estate, it is not labelled as the raw/full source.

scoped_methods.boundary: A method body is not silently counted as a full theory manuscript.

chat_source_graft.boundary: The source layer is additive. Conversation-memory evidence is visibly graded beneath a full export and cannot overwrite the placeholder or silently crown completion.

locks: Full bodies first. Census cards second.
The body is where the door says it is.
The body’s own boundary outranks the package label.
A shaped standalone is not automatically the raw source.
A scoped method is not automatically a theory manuscript.
A chat-source excerpt is not automatically the fullest source or a completed theory.
Conversation memory is source custody, not a substitute for the full export.
A project trunk is no longer allowed to stand in for its children.
A title earns retrieval, not a completed-body crown.
